# AION Wellness

> AION es el sistema que ayuda a ordenar, controlar y hacer crecer tu negocio de fitness y bienestar.

## About
AION is a web-based management system for gyms and wellness centers in Venezuela. It helps operators centralize clients, memberships, payments, access and daily cash in one place, with remote visibility and a more organized operation.

## Capabilities
- Centralized member management (search by name or cédula)
- Membership tracking and renewals
- Access control at the front desk
- Daily cash closing with clear numbers
- Remote visibility for gym owners
